description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of samples across different subtasks in the MMRA benchmark. The chart is divided into multiple colored slices, each representing a distinct subtask. The size of each slice corresponds to the number of samples assigned to that subtask, with the exact count displayed as an integer within the slice and the corresponding percentage of the total benchmark shown in parentheses. According to the accompanying text, the benchmark contains a total of 1,024 annotated samples, and the ObservationAngle (OA) subtask has the largest share with 126 samples (12.28%), while the NearSameEntity subtask has the smallest, with only 65 samples due to labeling difficulties. The chart visually emphasizes the relative proportions of each subtask, allowing for quick comparison of their representation within the overall dataset. A legend is not visible in the provided image, so the mapping between colors and subtask names must be inferred from the text or an external key. The percentages sum to 100%, confirming that all subtasks are accounted for in the distribution.
